info.title: Seedance 2.5 Flash Video Edit API
info.description: Seedance 2.5 Flash video editing API, edits an input video — replace subjects, add/remove objects, restyle or repaint regions

post.description:
- Video editing on an input video — replace subjects, add/remove objects, restyle or repaint regions
- Describe the change directly in the prompt, e.g. "Remove all passers-by in @video1, keep only the main character"
- Input exactly 1 video to edit (required, `4`–`30` seconds) + optional reference images (0–10) + reference audio (0–5); the output length and aspect ratio follow the input video
- Asynchronous processing mode, use the returned task ID to [query status](/en/api-manual/task-management/get-task-detail)
- Generated video links are valid for 24 hours, please save them promptly

prompt.description:
Text prompt describing the desired edit. Supports both Chinese and English, recommended no more than 500 characters for Chinese. Maximum prompt length: 10000 tokens

**Details:**
- Describe the change you want directly, e.g. "Remove all passers-by in @video1, keep only the main character"
- You can use natural language to specify the purpose of each material, e.g., "replace the character in @video1 with the person in @image1"
- The model will automatically understand the correspondence between material numbers and their intended uses
prompt.example: Remove all passers-by in @video1, keep only the main character

video_urls.description:
Input video URL array, **required; exactly 1 video**

**Requirement:** Provide exactly 1 video — the video to edit. The output length and aspect ratio follow this video.

**Video requirements:**
- Supported formats: `.mp4`, `.mov`
- Resolution: 480p, 720p, 1080p, 4K
- Duration: `4` ~ `30` seconds
- Aspect ratio (width/height): `0.4` ~ `2.5`
- Width/height pixels: `300` ~ `6000` px
- Frame pixels (width × height): `409,600` ~ `8,295,044` (e.g., 640×640 ~ 3326×2494)
- Max size per video: `200MB`
- Frame rate: `24` ~ `60` FPS
- Total request body size must not exceed `64MB`, do not use Base64 encoding
- Specific codec, resolution, and other media validity checks are performed by the model
- Video URLs must be directly accessible by the server

image_urls.description:
Reference image URL array, **optional; 1–10 images when provided**

**Requirement:** `video_urls` is required for this model; images are optional supplementary references.

**Role description:**

| Media Type | Role | Typical Usage |
|---------|------|----------|
| Image | `reference_image` | Style reference, product image, replacement subject (specified via prompt) |

**Image requirements:**
- Supported formats: `.jpeg`, `.png`, `.webp`
- Aspect ratio (width/height): `0.4` ~ `2.5`
- Width/height pixels: `300` ~ `6000` px
- Max size per image: `30MB`
- Total request body size must not exceed `64MB`, do not use Base64 encoding
- Image URLs must be directly accessible by the server

audio_urls.description:
Reference audio URL array, **optional; 1–5 clips when provided**

**Requirement:** `video_urls` is required for this model; audio clips are optional supplementary references.

**Role description:**

| Media Type | Role | Typical Usage |
|---------|------|----------|
| Audio | `reference_audio` | Background music, sound effects, voice/dialogue reference |

**Audio requirements:**
- Supported formats: `.wav`, `.mp3`
- Duration per clip: `2` ~ `30` seconds, max 5 clips, total duration of all audio ≤ `30` seconds
- Max size per clip: `15MB`
- Total request body size must not exceed `64MB`, do not use Base64 encoding
- Audio URLs must be directly accessible by the server

duration.description:
Output video duration (seconds), defaults to `-1`

**Details:**
- You can omit this field; if provided, only `-1` is accepted, and the output length follows the input video
- Custom durations are rejected

quality.description:
Video resolution, defaults to `720p`

**Options:**
- `480p`: Lower clarity, lower cost
- `720p`: Standard clarity, this is the default

aspect_ratio.description:
Video aspect ratio, defaults to `adaptive`

**Options:**
- `adaptive`: the output aspect ratio follows the input video; you can also omit this field
- Fixed ratios such as `16:9` or `9:16` are rejected

generate_audio.description:
Whether to generate synchronized audio, defaults to `true`

**Options:**
- `true`: Video includes synchronized audio at no additional charge
- `false`: no new audio is generated

callback_url.description:
HTTPS callback URL for task completion

**Callback timing:**
- Triggered when the task is completed or failed
- Sent after billing confirmation is complete

**Security restrictions:**
- Only HTTPS protocol is supported
- Callbacks to private IP addresses are prohibited (127.0.0.1, 10.x.x.x, 172.16-31.x.x, 192.168.x.x, etc.)
- URL length must not exceed `2048` characters

**Callback mechanism:**
- Timeout: `10` seconds
- Up to `3` retries after failure (at `1`/`2`/`4` seconds after failure respectively)
- Callback response body format is consistent with the task query endpoint response format
- A 2xx status code is considered successful; other status codes trigger retries

can_cancel.description: Whether the task can be cancelled. Seedance 2.5 Flash does not support user cancellation; this field always returns `false`.

video_duration.description: Video duration (seconds). For video editing, this is the input video duration rounded up to the next whole second
